## Problem and change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and feature note
in docs/Features/ when applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and their outcomes, including any skipped checks and why.
Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Review notes

Mention migrations, configuration changes, dependencies and material risks.

- [ ] Branch targets main directly and covers one feature or fix.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where needed.
- [ ] Feature note and relevant API, data model or decision docs are updated.
- [ ] No credentials or private donor information are included.
